page0.text:
She is left alone.
There is no longer any meaning in the boy's war.
No longer a Master, he charges off into danger anyway. Meanwhile, the girl who is the cause of it all is resting at home.
The reality sinks in.

page1.text:
"He's gone to the forest... Do you regret this, Sakura?"
The servant inquires her master's feelings.
Eyes gloomy, the girl shakes her head once.

page2.text:
"...How could I feel regret now, after all this time, Rider?"
"Yes. It was a pointless question."
"Yeah. But while it does hurt... I know it's wrong to feel this way, but I'm also very happy to know that Senpai is doing all this for my sake."
Even as she says it, pain fills her expression.
Her lips feel practically sewn together by her guilt, even as she speaks of joy.

page3.text:
"But he's making a mistake. Grandfather won't show any mercy. Senpai could always get killed as long as he's out there fighting.
Worst of all, though..."
It'll be a problem for her if she lets him get involved any further.
The future holds nothing good for either of them.

page4.text:
That's why she hoped he would give up on the war and go back to their normal life.
She doesn't have much time left, anyway.
She'd prefer to live the rest of it for him.
However...
Beneath that desire, she feels a glimmer of hope,
that his fighting might allow them to be together longer.
No, she's simply delighted to see that her beloved is fighting and getting hurt on her behalf.

page5.text:
She doesn't want him to fight.
But she's overjoyed that he's doing it for her.
Two competing wishes vie for her heart, and she's stuck unable to decide which one matters more.

page6.text:
"...That's a lie. I'm not on the fence at all."
She mumbles in anguish, keenly aware of her own dark nature.
That's right.
Actually, she wants him to fight. She wants him to save her. To make up for all the time during which he had never noticed her.
So...it's all right if he gets hurt.
She's thinking something she never should.

page7.text:
"Hah, khh...!"
She clutches her chest in pain.
The worms inside her wriggle up and down her nerves, as if responding to her dark desires.
...It was only an instant.
That single thought of him getting hurt is enough to make the worms violate her body even more.

page8.text:
Wriggle, wriggle.
Wriggle, wriggle.
Wriggle, wriggle, wriggle.
All their squirming in her body starts to make her ears ring.
A chill runs through her blood.
My body is so disgusting, so wicked, to be aroused by something like this.
...The worms that dissolved in her blood become a sweet poison, heating her body.
They swell and roil like waves, swallowing her consciousness.
When she gets aroused like this, she always thinks:

page9.text:
These defiled arms and legs can't be human.
The dark longing makes her stumble, and she tumbles to the ground in a tangle of hair and limbs.
She can't stop breathing. Her spine fuses together like sticky sap.
It's no different from the things attached to her nerves.
The more she tries to resist them, the deeper the worms invade her nerves, melting her mind away, until...
She feels like she's become a worm.
The ominous vision grips her entire body.

page10.text:
"Sakura."
"...I'm fine. I'm still all right. More importantly, I have a favor to ask, Rider. Please go with Senpai."
"...I'll go if you if you order it. But Sakura, your body will not last much longer. Having me act will only shorten your remaining life. Are you sure about this?"

page11.text:
"...Yeah. It's because I don't have much time left.
I'm still myself now, but if I lose focus, I don't know what I'll do... My memories are getting more vague each day, and I can't feel my arms and legs anymore. My sense of time is all over the place, and I can't even keep track of a day anymore.
...Even this morning, when I watched Senpai leave, it felt like a whole week went by."

page12.text:
She says it as if it doesn't particularly bother her.
...She's already accepted her death.
Even as she tries not to shamefully cling to hope, she wants to protect him.

page13.text:
"...I understand. By your command, I will guard Shirou Emiya."
"Thanks, and sorry, Rider. If I'm not good anymore, find someone new to contract with right away. I'd...rather it not be Senpai, but I guess it's all right if it's you."
She forces herself to smile.
The black-clad Servant nods once and leaves her Master.

page14.text:
"...This is an ill breeze. I will need to use my Noble Phantasm, if you don't mind."
"Yeah. If Senpai's in danger, bring him home."
"I know. But Sakura...
I think we should be more cautious of that priest than the old man."
Rider leaves with that last remark.

page15.text:
...
That was a surprise.
Her Servant doesn't give her opinions. She has a stoic personality and carries out orders exactly as they're given.
Until now, she's never made so much as a suggestion.
